Fixed - both refresh mutations now invalidate `"DBKeys"` alongside `"Models"`:

```ts
- invalidatesTags: ["Models"],
+ invalidatesTags: ["Models", "DBKeys"],
```

applied to `refreshProviderModels` and `refreshProviderKeyModels`, with a comment recording why.

Confirmed the finding before fixing: `DBKey.models` (types/governance.ts:71) is the same per-key model list a refresh rewrites, and the consumers that would have gone stale are `routingRuleSheet.tsx:85`, `pricingOverrideSheet.tsx:514`, `scopedPricingOverridesView.tsx:213`, `virtualKeySheet.tsx:282` and `onboardingWidget.tsx:75` - the pickers where a newly discovered model most needs to be selectable.

Chose invalidation over patching `getAllKeys`: the provider-wide mutation returns an array, so patching would mean mapping `ModelProviderKey` -> `DBKey` across differing shapes (`id` vs `key_id`, `provider_id`) for every element. The RTK Query docs call invalidation the simpler and safer option in that situation, and the extra `/api/keys` fetch only happens on an explicit refresh-button click.

Typecheck clean.

Fixed in b80bff85 — updated `invalidatesTags` to include `"Providers"` and `{ type: "Providers" as const, id: provider }`, so provider list/detail views refresh after model discovery updates key status on the backend.
